content.title: What Channel Is WrestleMania On? How To Watch WrestleMania 2026 Live
content.text: Published April 18, 2026, 6:45 p.m. ET Decider Streamline: 'Beef' Season 2 on Netflix, 'Margo's Got Money Troubles' on Apple TV and More0 seconds of 59 secondsVolume 0% It’s the Super Bowl of the professional wrestling season as the WWE presents WrestleMania 42! The greatest spectacle in sports entertainment returns to Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas as we prepare for two nights of must-see excitement! Can Randy Orton capture his 15th World Championship —trailing only John Cena (17) and Ric Flair (16) — by defeating his longtime friend Cody Rhodes? Will the WWE Universe once again acknowledge Roman Reigns as a champion? Only if the Tribal Chief can defeat CM Punk in Sunday’s main event. The undercard is also overflowing with intrigue as assurgent superstar Oba Femi makes his WrestleMania debut against Brock Lesnar, AJ Lee returns to WrestleMania to defend her Intercontinental Championship against Becky Lynch, Seth Rollins and Gunther collide in a battle of future Hall of Famers, and probable future Mania main eventer Trick Williams looks to capture singles gold when he battles Sami Zayn for the United States title. What channel is WrestleMania on tonight? How can you watch all the action live? Here’s everything you need to know. What Channel Is WrestleMania On? WrestleMania is streaming exclusively on ESPN Unlimited, but the first hour of both nights (6:00-7:00 p.m. ET) will also air on ESPN2 (Saturday) and ESPN (Sunday). How To Watch WrestleMania Live Online: Visit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGEWrestleMania will be available to stream on ESPN Unlimited. You can bundle ESPN Unlimited, Hulu, and Disney+ for $35.99/month for 12 months or purchase ESPN Unlimited as a standalone service for $29.99/month. You can also bundle ESPN Unlimited with FOX One for $39.99/month. Additionally, you can access ESPN Unlimited with a subscription to DIRECTV, FuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, Comcast Xfinity, Spectrum TV, Verizon, FiOS, U-Verse, or Cox. A WrestleMania replay will be available on the ESPN app shortly after the conclusion of the post-show. Is There A Free Trial of ESPN Unlimited? ESPN doesn’t directly offer a free trial of Unlimited, but you can sign up for a free trial of DIRECTV, FuboTV, or Hulu + Live TV. All three platforms offer access to ESPN Unlimited in select packages. Depending on your location, you can also receive a free month of ESPN Unlimited by linking your ESPN and DraftKings accounts. Photos: WWE Will WrestleMania Be on Netflix? WrestleMania won’t be available on Netflix in the United States, but Netflix subscribers in certain countries will be able to watch the event on the streamer.
